2.14.15
Rectangle.Width
The Rectangle.Width element specifies the width of a Rectangle. This element is optional. If this
element is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is
interpreted as the width of the rectangle's container (such as a Rectangle or Body) minus the value
of the peer Rectangle.Left element, if specified.
Following is the parent element of the Rectangle.Width element.
Parent elements
Rectangle
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Rectangle.Width element.
 <xsd:element name="Width" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
